name: Mr. Brunner
excerpt: Mr. Brunner is Percy's Latin teacher who uses a wheelchair and has a collection of Roman armor.
notes: Mr. Brunner is a middle-aged Latin teacher at Yancy Academy who uses a motorized wheelchair. He is known for his engaging teaching style, telling stories and jokes, and allowing games in class. He has a collection of Roman armor and weapons and expects high performance from Percy, despite his learning difficulties.
